name: XUSD
oneLiner: XUSD is BabelFish's Rootstock dollar token, minted 1:1 from a basket of bridged stablecoins (DLLR, USDT, USDC, DAI) with basket-balance constraints.
collateral: Rootstock basket of accepted stablecoins, dominated by DLLR with bridged USDT, USDC, DAI variants, and small DOC exposure
pegMechanism: BabelFish mints XUSD 1:1 from accepted stablecoins and allows redemption into accepted bAssets, subject to basket-balance constraints and balancing fees

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: XUSD is a reserve-backed aggregator whose current DLLR and Rootstock bridged USDT exposures inherit upstream issuer or protocol access surfaces; the reviewed XUSD controller evidence does not establish a separate holder-level blacklist path for every branch.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Current BabelFish and Rootstock evidence identifies the XUSD masset manager controller and the linked DLLR, bridged USDT, and DOC reserve branches. The inherited posture is retained because the reviewed sources do not prove a complete holder freeze or transfer-control inventory across XUSD and every upstream reserve branch.

mintAuthority.summary: XUSD is BabelFish's meta-stablecoin aggregator on Rootstock: any user mints XUSD 1:1 by depositing an accepted bAsset stablecoin (DLLR, USDT, USDC, DAI, DOC) and redeems back, subject to basket-balance constraints and fees. The masset manager (0x1440) is proxy-admin'd by a 2-of-5 Gnosis Safe and its owner is a 3-of-5 Gnosis Safe, together controlling the accepted-asset basket.

controls.label: BabelFish masset manager (XUSD aggregator, 0x1440)
controls.capDescription: XUSD minting is user-driven 1:1 against accepted bAsset deposits and basket-balance constraints in the masset manager, not discretionary supply creation.
controls.evidence: At Rootstock block 8935202: XUSD token 0xb5999795 owner() returned masset manager proxy 0x1440d19436beeaf8517896bffb957a88ec95a00f (confirmed as a contract). Masset manager EIP-1967 proxy admin slot returned 0x37a706259f5201c03f6cb556a960f30f86842d01 (Gnosis Safe multisig, 2-of-5). Masset manager owner() returned 0xbd687d470a7e8b36c666968bb79376904725e4dd (Gnosis Safe multisig, 3-of-5). Minting is user-driven 1:1 against deposited bAssets, not discretionary.

controls.label: BabelFish multisig — masset manager owner (3-of-5 Gnosis Safe, 0xbd687d)
controls.evidence: At Rootstock block 8935202: getOwners() on 0xbd687d returned 5 signers; required() returned 3. This is the legacy Gnosis multisig pattern (not Safe v1.x). Controls basket composition and protocol parameters.

controls.label: BabelFish proxy admin multisig (2-of-5 Gnosis Safe, 0x37a706)
controls.evidence: At Rootstock block 8935202: EIP-1967 proxy admin of masset manager = 0x37a706; getOwners() returned 5 signers; required() returned 2. This 2-of-5 multisig controls upgrades to the masset manager implementation.

upgradeability.controlRef: BabelFish proxy admin multisig (2-of-5 Gnosis Safe, 0x37a706)

review.evidence: At Rootstock block 8935202: XUSD token owner() = masset manager proxy 0x1440d194; masset manager EIP-1967 proxy admin = Gnosis multisig 0x37a706 (2-of-5); masset manager owner() = Gnosis multisig 0xbd687d (3-of-5). Both multisigs enumerated via getOwners()/required() on-chain. Mint path confirmed as user-driven 1:1 aggregator. Full control chain verified. Upgrade-authority follow-up (2026-07-21): re-read at Rootstock block 9075576 confirms the masset manager's EIP-1967 implementation slot resolves to 0x92d7ad53b2d824277d22877d5299c2af479da322 (31,859-byte deployed contract) and the admin slot still resolves to the 2-of-5 Safe 0x37a706259f5201c03f6cb556a960f30f86842d01, whose getOwners() returned the same five signers already on file — this multisig, not any single key, is the sole path that can change XUSD's mint-critical masset-manager logic, and no timelock was found on the proxy admin path.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: XUSD is minted and redeemed against accepted dollar-stablecoin basket assets subject to balancing constraints.
